title: K-flat tensor models on the localized open site
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open, and P,N complexes of O_X-modules which are K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Suppose both the global module category and the localized module category over U have derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Write R for exact over-site restriction [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], and P′,N′ for its termwise restrictions. Then P′ and N′ are K-flat for the localized sheaf tensor, and R(Q(Tot(P tensor N))) is isomorphic to Q(Tot(P′ tensor N′)) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. This assertion involves no prescribed local models or input isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 06YC K-flat pullback and Tag 08DX local tensor computation; sheaf tensor restriction is Modules Tag 01CD

proof.text: Identify the localized module category over U with the modules on U.toScheme using Scheme.Modules.overEquiv. Its sheaf tensor comparison is obtained on local pure tensors and commutes with sheafification, arbitrary sums and differentials. Under this exact equivalence, the termwise overFunctor becomes canonical open restriction. Apply openRestriction_isKFlat to P and N, and transport the acyclic-tensor criteria back through the exact tensor-compatible equivalence. This gives both K-flat clauses. The empty-open case is vacuous on stalks.

Apply openRestriction_totalTensor_iso for P and N. The same equivalence commutes with tensor totalization, by summing its natural pure-tensor comparisons in each degree; the two differentials and their signs commute with those maps. Thus the complex comparison transports back to the localized site. Apply Q to this isomorphism and compose with overFunctor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors. No perfectness or specified local model enters this step.

theorem localizedOpen_kFlat_tensor_restriction (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (P N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (hN : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N) :
    let R := SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U
    let P' := (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let N' := (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N
    CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf.over U) P' ∧
      CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf.over U) N' ∧
      Nonempty (R.mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N
          (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf)))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P' N'
          (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (X.sheaf.over U)))))
